Name: Measure My Way
Author: BambooKatt
Description:
[b][size=4]💫[/size][/b][b][size=4] What this mod does[/size][/b]
Measure My Way never touches your save file. The game's internal fish size data always stays in inches, exactly as vanilla intends — this mod only changes what's [i]displayed[/i] to you, live, based on a simple preference:

[list]
[*][b]Metric[/b] or [b]Imperial[/b] — pick whichever you actually want to see[/*]
[*]Works in [b]any language[/b], not just English. Playing in Japanese but wish it showed inches? Covered.[/*]
[*][b]Per-player[/b] in multiplayer — everyone sees their own preferred unit[/*]
[*]Configurable in-game via [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] (optional but recommended)[/*]
[*]Localized menu in 16 languages[/*]
[/list]
[b][size=4]✅ What it affects
[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]The size shown when you reel in a fish[/*]
[*]The "Biggest Catch" size shown in the Collections tab (Fish page)[/*]
[/list]
[b][size=4]❌ What it doesn't affect
[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Your save file — fish sizes are always stored in inches internally, same as vanilla[/*]
[*]Other mods with their own fishing UI (e.g. logbook-style mods) that don't use the game's built-in size display — these are outside this mod's scope[/*]
[/list]
[b][size=4]💞 Compatibility[/size][/b]
Should be compatible with everything — this mod only intercepts the specific text used for vanilla fish size display, nothing else. Tested with modded fish from other mods, works the same.
